snippet.title: BACKFIRE (Game) - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
COMING FALL 2018

VISIT https://www.backfire-game.com/ FOR MORE INFORMATION


Backfire is a fast paced action game about cleansing a demon from an arcade machine. Upgrade your tools, and avoid certain death.

One twist: your ship only fires from the back.
